name: trakt_tv_shows
description: Build taste-oriented public TV-show discovery through Trakt. Use for 'what TV show should I start?', 'find shows like Severance and Dark', 'I want a funny mystery with short episodes', 'what TV shows are trending or popular on Trakt?', related series, show details, or official trailer/video links. The recommend action blends bounded current Trakt show lists with related shows from up to three supplied favorites, then returns a source-ranked candidate set. Runtime means typical episode runtime, not total series length. This public Client-ID integration does not read a Trakt account's history, ratings, watchlist, or personalized recommendations. A streaming-list signal does not identify a provider or prove current availability.

action.description: Public Trakt TV operation. Use recommend for a mood/preferences request; search for title or overview lookup; details, related, or videos for one show; or a named discovery list.

request.description: Natural-language TV-viewing mood, constraints, and optional favorite shows. Used by recommend. Quoted titles or phrases such as 'shows I loved: Severance, Dark' improve deterministic reference extraction.

query.description: TV-show title or text query for search, or a title fallback for details, related, and videos when show_id is omitted.

show_id.description: Trakt show slug or supported external ID for details, related, or videos. Prefer the ids.slug returned by an earlier result.

reference_titles.description: Up to three favorite TV-show titles used as similarity anchors by recommend.

genres.description: Optional Trakt genre slugs such as comedy, thriller, mystery, horror, reality, or science-fiction. Recommend infers common genre hints from request when omitted.

years.description: Optional Trakt premiere year or year range filter, for example 2010-2026.

runtimes.description: Optional typical episode-runtime range in minutes, for example 20-60. This is not total series length.

ratings.description: Optional Trakt rating percentage range, for example 70-100.

max_results.description: Maximum normalized shows. Recommend clamps this to at least 3 and at most 15; default 8. Other actions default 10.

include_videos.description: For recommend, fetch bounded public video metadata for top candidates. Default true.

video_limit.description: How many top recommendation candidates receive video lookup. Default 3.

availability.setup_hint: Set TRAKT_API_KEY to the Trakt application Client ID in the active mode env file. Public TV metadata actions do not require a Client Secret or OAuth token.
